summary: Frontend testing for shamanic journey blank page bug fix. Verified the hook-order fix in useTimerClock.js resolves the ReferenceError that caused blank pages when starting shamanic journeys.
critical_code_review_comments: - Refs (currentSegmentIndexRef, segmentEndTimesRef, segmentsLengthRef) now declared at lines 22-24
- Computed constants (segmentEndTimes, currentSegmentIndex) declared after refs at lines 60-72
- useEffect hooks that sync refs to computed values at lines 84-94
- This ordering prevents 'Cannot access before initialization' ReferenceError
test_credentials: No login required for shamanic route
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 143 verified shamanic journey blank page bug fix. No ReferenceError in console. Exit Journey button returns to modal detail view. Bug is FIXED.

bug_verification.original_issue: Shamanic journeys open a blank page when starting journey
bug_verification.root_cause: Hook-order issue in useTimerClock.js - refs for currentSegmentIndex/segmentEndTimes/segmentsLength were declared after computed constants, causing 'Cannot access before initialization' ReferenceError
bug_verification.fix_applied: Refs declared before computed constants in useTimerClock.js
bug_verification.verification_result: FIXED - PracticeTimer renders correctly with all components visible
